text:
incident-bot: PAGING: high rate of 5xx responses observed from inference-gateway-prod (svc=inference-gateway, env=prod). Alert group: http_5xx_rate > 2% over 1m across region us-east-1. Link: https://pager.redwood/alerts/1780

mike_oncall: hitting this now, thanks for the page. moving to #incident-bridge. anyone on-call for LB/edge?

sarah_ops: i'm oncall for edge — looking at envoy stats, saw spike in 502/504 and a small bump in 500s.

raja_infra: seeing cluster-level upstream_5xx_count rising. top upstreams: model-pool-a, model-pool-b. Also noticing Envoy downstream_rq_5xx increasing on listener 8443.

leah_support: customer PD-241 reporting timeouts in the same window, multiple errors from enterprise tenants. estimated ~7% of requests failing for them. Can we confirm scope?

mike_oncall: initial impact assessment: global p95 latency slightly elevated, errors concentrated in inference-gateway-prod in us-east-1 and spilling into us-west-2. Traffic rate unchanged — looks like a routing/config issue rather than load.

aj_dev: can you paste the current LB/route config dump? I'll look for recent changes.

raja_infra: pulling last deployed route config from control-plane. hold on...

incident-bot: deploy-bot: New config commit 2026-03-15T02:12Z applied to gateway-service-prod by infra-rotate CI (commit id: a1b2c3d).

raja_infra: that commit updated retry policy and circuit-breaker defaults (lowered max_retries to 1, adjusted per-host connection limits).

mike_oncall: could that be causing a retry amplification or misrouting? We started seeing 5xx right after that window.

aj_dev: paste of the relevant snippet (from control plane):
```
route: 
  match: /v1/generate
  route: 
    cluster: model-pool-a
    retry_policy:
      retry_on: gateway-error,connect-failure,refused-stream
      num_retries: 1
    timeout: 10s
    per_request_timeout: true
    upstream_circuit_breakers:
      max_connections: 10000
      max_pending_requests: 1000
```

raja_infra: the change reduced per-cluster connections and set aggressive retry_on flags on the public route — that could cause immediate 502s if backend returned gateway-errors and Envoy retried to overloaded backends, or hit per-host limits.

mike_oncall: we need a quick mitigation that reduces customer impact. Options: 1) disable retries on public route; 2) route traffic away from model-pool-a to model-pool-c (lower risk); 3) bump circuit breaker thresholds.

dana_sre: recommend disabling retries first — minimal risk, quick patch via control-plane hotpatch. Then monitor error rate. If still bad, shift weights.

mike_oncall: agree. raja, can you hotpatch control-plane to set num_retries: 0 for /v1/generate and push to live?

raja_infra: doing it now. command: `cxctl route hotpatch --service gateway-service-prod --route /v1/generate --set retry_policy.num_retries=0`

incident-bot: changelog-bot: Hotpatch initiated by raja_infra at 02:27Z (change id hp-9981).

raja_infra: hotpatch applied to 6/6 proxies in us-east-1, 3/3 in us-west-2. rolling.

mike_oncall: watching metrics…

(1m)

raja_infra: errors dropped to ~1.1% in us-east-1 within 90s. downstream_rq_5xx trending down.

leah_support: PD-241 engineer confirmed reduced errors from their side, they see near normal traffic.

mike_oncall: good. Marking immediate mitigation: disabled retries. Next steps: investigate why retry policy change caused increased 5xx — maybe retries were masking upstream instability and now hit per-host limits, or the retry_on flags included gateway-error and caused cyclic retries.

aj_dev: checking logs for recent upstream flaps around the same time. Found steady 502 responses from model-pool-a host ip 10.2.3.14 with backend logs showing "segfault in model runtime" at 02:11Z. That host had been force-drained earlier but was supposed to be out of rotation.

raja_infra: ah — control plane update may have rebalanced and sent traffic to a partially drained host. Circuit breaker thresholds prevented full failover so Envoy retried and amplified 502.

mike_oncall: action items: 1) cordon/egress 10.2.3.14 from LB pools; 2) remediate model runtime crash; 3) review rollout gating for control-plane config changes.

raja_infra: cordon command issued: `kubectl annotate node n-10-2-3-14 maintenance=true` and removed from pool via backend-api. Confirming drain: 02:40Z done.

tim_elastic: raising a monitor to alert if hotpatches touch retry_policy in future without canary.

dana_sre: we should also revert to safer circuit-breaker defaults temporarily. raja, can you bump max_pending_requests to 2000 across prod?

raja_infra: yanking that change in a second: `cxctl route hotpatch --service gateway-service-prod --set upstream_circuit_breakers.max_pending_requests=2000`

incident-bot: changelog-bot: Hotpatch hp-9982 applied at 02:45Z (bumped pending_requests).

mike_oncall: monitoring both metrics: errors continue falling, backend error logs show fewer hits to 10.2.3.14 after drain. aggregate 5xx now ~0.3% — within normal.

leah_support: notifying customers: I'll send an update to PD-241 and a short banner to affected tenants that we mitigated a routing issue and are continuing investigation.

leah_support: draft: "We experienced elevated 5xx errors impacting some requests to inference features between 02:10-02:45 UTC. We applied mitigations (disabled retries and rerouted traffic) and error rates are back to normal. We are investigating root cause and will follow up."

mike_oncall: timeline for postmortem: incident created 02:11Z, causes traced to config deploy a1b2c3d at 02:12Z + an unhealthy host that received traffic. Mitigation at 02:27Z (disable retries) and full drain at 02:40Z.

aj_dev: root cause hypothesis: race between control-plane route rollouts and host drain state — control plane considered host healthy during the rollout and updated retry policy which interacted badly with partially drained host, producing retry amplification and 5xx spike.

dana_sre: next steps for long-term: - add canary gating for retry/cb changes - ensure control plane queries node draining state before applying live route weight changes - add test that simulates partially drained backends + new retry policy to catch amplification

raja_infra: filing infra ticket to revert immediate change to CI workflow and add a preflight check (ticket INF-1092).

mike_oncall: great. I'll mark this as resolved in the incident tracker once final notes are added. Thanks everyone for the quick triage.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: errors returned to baseline 02:46Z. Handed back to owners: infra/edge/devex. Postmortem assigned to mike_oncall, due 72h.

leah_support: posting customer follow-up now.

mike_oncall: will draft the postmortem, include timeline, config diff, and action items. Closing thread when PM is posted.
